plan.name: Show reader chart changes against captured baselines
plan.summary: Deliver all of #648, step 8 of parent #571, in one plumbing pull request: add a deterministic reader comparison to the existing statement and bound diff, comparing canonical state identities and labeled endpoint triples, retaining changed memberships and concrete occurrence multisets before hiding as well as visible additions and removals, and showing the complete new chart with the named baseline, exact model/include/view/lock identities, view-change and model-source-change qualifications, and both bounds with a displayed-scope qualification when bounds differ, without claiming behavioral equivalence from equal charts. New-project revisions use the immediately preceding selected modeled proposal, while amendments capture the ratified project at one resolved commit and retain that immutable Current/Target baseline across revisions, answers, saved results and restarts; both the drafting check and independent final check use detached caller-owned authority, require a drafting-supplied baseline/view.json for a legacy missing view and validate it through the existing model gate, complete TLC graph, invariant replay and hiding checks at the original bounds, refuse stale or missing required comparisons with actionable baseline diagnostics, and preserve explicit over-500-state limitations without inventing empty graphs, shrinking bounds or recursively copying comparison histories. Publish the comparison through formalize.Changes and checked proposal readers, factory comments and markers, literal-safe Mermaid, and the shared native script-free SVG renderer with visibly distinct added and removed state and arrow annotations and a legend; retain existing statement warnings, bound tables, ratification hashes, ordinary-chart behavior and indivisible comment/marker size refusals, update the existing factory doubles and publication tests that currently return revisions or amendments without comparison evidence, and extend pinned-TLC integration coverage. Persist the checked proposal comparison separately in .invariant/comparison.json, protect and carry it from the original project through synthesis, snapshot and validate it in verification without accepting agent replacement artifacts, and include it in structured and Markdown receipts, reader JSON/SVG companions, dashboard proposal cards and receipt evidence pages with the same baseline and qualifications; final-model charts are recomputed as before and explicitly distinguished from the retained proposal comparison when their source identities differ, comparison evidence stays outside verification verdicts, assurance, fingerprints and locks, stale exports are removed on reuse, and immutable dashboard identities bind both source snapshots and rendered contents with restart validation and visible diagnostics for damaged comparisons. Update SPEC.md with existing supporting decision citations, the README's short linked description within 400 lines, docs/statecharts.md, docs/factory.md, docs/gate.md and docs/dashboard.md to document the API, baseline selection, legacy repair, bounded/view-qualified meaning, provenance, rendering and recovery; the merger records the new comparison and baseline policy decision because plumbing cannot write decisions/, and runs the added pinned-TLC integration coverage if Docker is unavailable to the builder, while applicable real Python and TLAPS CI suites remain required.

tests.name: TestComparison648CanonicalChanges
tests.says: Comparisons retain exact added and removed states and labeled arrows, including hidden changes, bind both source identities, survive serialization, and stay detached and identical under graph dump reordering.

tests.name: TestComparison648ViewHidingAndScope
tests.says: Relabeling and hiding are identified as view changes, changed hidden model actions remain visible before hiding even under the same reader label, differing bounds retain both scopes, and missing or oversized baselines never become empty graphs.

tests.name: TestComparison648MermaidSVGAnnotations
tests.says: Mermaid and native SVG keep the complete candidate, named baseline, both identities and qualifications, with added and removed state and arrow annotations, dashed removals, literal text and no active content.

tests.name: TestComparison648ConsecutiveRevisionsAndSavedResults
tests.says: Each revision compares with its immediately preceding proposal, including view-only changes at an equal statement hash; the check process and final check agree, and saved results and statement diffs retain the same comparison.

tests.name: TestComparison648LegacyBaselineRepairAndAuthority
tests.says: A legacy baseline needs a supplied, TLC-checked view at its captured model and lock; missing and invalid views are actionable during drafting and final checking, and editing staged old source or bounds cannot change the comparison baseline.

tests.name: TestComparison648AmendmentBaselineAndReceiptSources
tests.says: An amendment keeps its captured ratified baseline through revisions and project writing, and receipts and their companions retain the original proposal comparison beside a differently synthesized final model without changing assurance or verification identity.

tests.name: TestComparison648FactoryCommentsAndRecovery
tests.says: Factory revision comments show the complete chart and qualified changes with both identities, markers and saved results recover the same comparison, and missing required comparison evidence prevents publication.

tests.name: TestComparison648FactoryRetainsRatifiedBaseline
tests.says: Factory amendments retain their captured ratification after the branch moves, preserve existing changed-invariant warnings, and reject tampered comparison evidence.

tests.name: TestComparison648DashboardProposalAndRestart
tests.says: Modeled proposal cards, public evidence pages and native SVG retain the checked comparison and immutable URLs across restart, and a corrupted saved comparison becomes an explicit diagnostic.

tests.name: TestComparison648DashboardReceiptKeepsProposalSources
tests.says: Receipt archive comparisons reach dashboard evidence pages and SVG with the same view and scope qualifications, preserve proposal identities beside a distinct final-model identity, and survive cache restart.

tests.name: TestComparison648VerificationValidatesCapturedEvidence
tests.says: Verification preserves validated proposal comparison sources beside freshly checked final-model sources, diagnoses tampered comparison evidence without losing the final chart, and keeps comparison presence and damage outside the verdict, claim and gate fingerprint.

tests.name: TestComparison648SynthesisPreservesCapturedProvenance
tests.says: Synthesis carries captured comparison bytes from the original project while assembling a new model, discards agent replacement provenance, and cannot invent a comparison for a project that has none.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and twelve acceptance tests covering the complete #648 change in one pull request. Check 3 passed: every acceptance test fails on the base as required, and `repo/` is unchanged.
